from pathlib import Path
from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.containers import Horizontal
from textual.widgets import Header, Footer, Tree, Static


class FileExplorerApp(App):
    """A Textual app with a directory tree on the left and text area on the right."""
    
    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("q", "quit", "Quit"),
    ]
    
    TITLE = "File Explorer"
    SUB_TITLE = "Browse files and view content"
    
    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Create the layout with tree and text area."""
        yield Header()
        yield Horizontal(
            Tree("📂 Current Directory"),
            Static(id="text_area", expand=True),
        )
        yield Footer()
    
    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Initialize the tree with current directory structure."""
        tree = self.query_one(Tree)
        self._populate_tree(tree.root, Path.cwd())
        
        text_area = self.query_one("#text_area", Static)
        text_area.update("Select a file to view content")
    
    def _populate_tree(self, parent_node, path: Path, max_depth: int = 3, current_depth: int = 0) -> None:
        """Recursively populate the tree with directory contents."""
        if current_depth >= max_depth:
            return
        
        try:
            for item in sorted(path.iterdir()):
                if item.name.startswith('.'):
                    continue
                
                if item.is_dir():
                    node = parent_node.add(f"📁 {item.name}")
                    self._populate_tree(node, item, max_depth, current_depth + 1)
                else:
                    parent_node.add(f"📄 {item.name}")
        except (PermissionError, OSError):
            pass
    
    def on_tree_select(self, message: Tree.Selected) -> None:
        """Handle tree selection to display file info."""
        node = message.node
        label = str(node.label)
        clean_label = label.lstrip("📁📄 ")
        
        text_area = self.query_one("#text_area", Static)
        text_area.update(f"Selected: {clean_label}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = FileExplorerApp()
    app.run()
